title: LLM agent security needs more than guardrails
hint: Madhu Shashanka, Chief Scientist at Concentric AI, explains why securing LLM tools and agents depends more on your data than on the model. Controls on model behavior, such as guardrails and injection detection, lower the rate of bad outcomes but never reach zero. Controls on what goes in are different, because you own the documents, systems, and credentials an agent can reach. He covers prompt injection, data leakage through connectors, overprivileged agents, and shadow AI. … More →

title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
hint: On 5 October 2026, Atlassian published a security advisory addressing a critical arbitrary file access vulnerability. It affects Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye. CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading all affected installations to a fixed version as soon as possible, starting with instances accessible from the internet. CERT-EU also recommends checking access logs for signs of exploitation.

title: 2026-014: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway
hint: On 27 September 2026, Citrix published a security bulletin addressing 8 vulnerabilities affecting customer-managed Citrix NetScaler ADC and Citrix NetScaler Gateway, among which 2 critical unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerabilities. Citrix has confirmed active exploitation of these 2 critical vulnerabilities in the wild. CERT-EU recommends updating affected software and running a compromise assessment on those exposed on the internet.

title: 2026-010: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway
hint: On 19 August 2026, Citrix published a security advisory addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities in NetScaler ADC (formerly Citrix ADC) and NetScaler Gateway (formerly Citrix Gateway). CERT-EU recommends updating affected devices as soon as possible.

title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
hint: On 12 October 2026, GitLab released versions 19.4.2, 19.3.4 and 19.2.8 of GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE), fixing 24 security issues among which a critical vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading self-managed GitLab CE/EE instances to a fixed version as soon as possible, starting with internet-facing instances.

title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
hint: On 21 October 2026, GitLab published a security advisory addressing several vulnerabilities among which a critical flaw that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server. CERT-EU recommends organisations to update affected assets as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing assets, and to run an assessment to identify compromised assets.

title: 2026-013: Critical Vulnerability in F5 BIG-IP APM
